content: Dual Training: Our teacher and student models have different vocabularies and incompatible tokenizations for the same sequence. To address this during distillation, we feed the teacher model a mix of teacher vocabulary-tokenized and student vocabulary-tokenized words within a single sequence. Coupled with the masked language modeling task, this encourages an implicit alignment of the teacher and student WordPiece embeddings, since the student vocabulary embedding may be used as context to predict a word tokenized by the teacher vocabulary and vice versa.
